customer_message.subject: Defective bathroom ventilation fan at Gartenweg 41, Frauenfeld - request for assistance
customer_message.body:
Dear Claims Team,

I am writing to request your help with a defect in my rented flat at Gartenweg 41, Frauenfeld, a 2-room flat. My landlord is Peter Ammann, a private landlord.

The ventilation fan in the bathroom is defective. The bathroom has no window, so the fan is the only ventilation there. It rattles loudly day and night, and I cannot sleep properly or use the flat normally in the evenings.

I reported the defect to Mr. Ammann in writing on 2 October 2026 and asked him to have it repaired. As of today, 21 October 2026, the fan has not been repaired and I have had no substantive reply.

Separately, some rooms in the flat feel cold. I am not sure whether the heating is actually faulty, so I cannot say at this stage.

I would like to know whether my legal expenses cover asserting my rights against the landlord regarding the fan, and what the next steps are. Please tell me which documents you need from me. I can send my tenancy agreement and copies of my correspondence with Mr. Ammann.

Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Drew Palmer
